name: Windcutting

project.prerequisites: A feather from a bird, once thought extinct, who dwells at the eye of an ever-whirling tornado

description: Whenever you use a melee signature ability that usually targets one creature, you can take a bane on the ability to target each enemy in a cube 3 within distance. If your signature ability would usually cause its target to become grabbed or restrained, each target in the area is instead [[/apply slowed eot]] until the end of their next turn.
